title: DuckLobby
body:
# 🦆 DuckLobby Plugin – The Ultimate /lobby Solution
DuckLobby is a high-performance, lightweight plugin designed for both network environments (BungeeCord/Velocity) and standalone Spigot/Paper instances. It redefines how players return to your server's starting point, turning the simple /lobby command into a seamless, polished experience.

# Key Features
Unlike basic teleportation scripts, DuckLobby focuses on customization and stability:

Smart Teleportation: Supports both /lobby and /hub aliases out of the box.

Warmup & Combat Logic: Prevent "combat logging" by setting a configurable delay. Movement can cancel the teleport, ensuring fair play.

Immersive Effects: Enhance the player experience with customizable sound effects and particle animations upon departure and arrival.

Cross-Server Support: Built with networks in mind, it provides lightning-fast redirection between different server instances via proxy.

Full Visual Control: Every message sent to the player—whether via Chat, ActionBar, or Titles—is fully configurable in the config.yml file.
